background.value: plain, single-color, light-colored background (light grey recommended); must contrast with face and clothing, no patterns or shadows

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, looking straight at camera, eyes open

glasses_policy.value: permitted if regularly worn; iris must be clearly and completely visible, no dark or tinted lenses, no reflective glare, frames cannot cover eyes

headwear_policy.value: not permitted except for religious or medical reasons; face must remain fully visible

face_visibility.value: full face must be clearly visible and centered, eyes open

size.evidence: German visa photos follow the Schengen standard of 35 x 45mm. Independent confirmation from how-to-germany.com explicitly states 'Visa photos for Germany and the Schengen area must meet the guidelines of German and European authorities' with 'a standardized image size of 35 mm x 45 mm.' The Schengen visa photo standard is uniformly 35x45mm across all member states. Multiple independent sources (passlens.com Schengen guide, photogov.net, feather-insurance.com) confirm this dimension.
